# TravelItineraryFitted

## Summary

Fitted views for every tier of the 4-size contract: badge (icon + title), strip (title + day/stop meta), tile (map thumbnail + title + meta), and card (hero map + title block). All tiers derive their meta line from the same `dayCount`/`stopCount` source as the isolated header, so counts never drift between formats.

## Usage

```ts
static fitted = TravelItineraryFitted;
```
